title: Super fun activity during a city trip!
text:
A tremendously fun and educational castanet workshop! We were welcomed by the enthusiastic Dutch-speaking Eva who has lived in Seville for years. She picked us up at a nice landmark and told us some facts about the neighborhood on the way to her studio. After about 5 minutes we arrived at the studio and met the castanets and learned to play the first rhythms ourselves. As a cherry on the cake, we even got a small flamenco demo from Eva herself! 💃

A super fun addition during a city trip and the way to get an interactive taste of Sevillian culture. Really recommended!
author: maaiker467

title: Fabulous to do.
text:
An unforgettable experience.
Eva accompanied me in my first steps with the castanets, and it was just fabulous.
Eva is a very conscientious person; she presents the different types of castanets and initiates you.
Some basic skills with which you leave and can already have fun at home.

author: Michael_D

title: Amazing experience!
text: Excellent experience! We took the class as a family, and it was an enjoyable and super fun experience! Eva is able to share fascinating information about flamenco and castanets, even in a short amount of time. It’s a pity it went by so quickly! I highly recommend it!
author: simonelW1503CI

title: Castanets convert
text: I loved it! Eva is lovely, very knowledgeable and very passionate about flamenco and playing the castanets. She was very kind to do the class just for me and she was very encouraging throughout. I learned a lot more than I was expecting and would highly recommend this class as a fun and educational way to spend an hour in the city.
author: O7805IAmicheller

title: Castanets, Laughter, and Flamenco
text: We attended the castanets workshop with five friends. Eva teaches everything enthusiastically and clearly, we laughed a lot and learned how to play. At the end, Eva treated us to a beautiful combination of castanets and flamenco. Highly recommended!
author: nielsk562

title: Don't hesitate: do it!
text: What a fun workshop! Eva is so professional and a fantastic role model. She gave us, both music and theater professionals, a wonderful challenge. Next to that, Eva is an excellent host and teacher, and we had a great time. Don't hesitate: do it!
author: 683jeroenv

title: Super cool hour of music!!
text: If you are looking for something to fill an hour, you have to do this!  Eva is wonderful and you pick up so much so quickly.  Apart from being a lot of fun, you can pick up the basics quickly and play along to all sorts of music.   Also, bizarrely I bet it’s really good if you have any form of adhd!!   Do it!
author: patricksZ8864VV

title: An incredible hour to learn about castanets!
text: Eva introduced us to castanets with great enthusiasm, pedagogy and generosity: do not hesitate to call on her to better understand and experience for yourself this traditional art in Seville!
author: 473guillaumeb

title: Highly recommended class!
text:
I had an amazing class with Eva! 
It was a fantastic first introduction to castañuelas (castanets). 
Eva is patient, kind, and incredibly generous with her teaching. 
She creates a warm, welcoming environment and can teach in multiple languages, which makes the class even more accessible and comfortable.
I enjoyed the class so much that I immediately asked to continue learning with her online—and I’ve been taking lessons ever since!

Highly recommend taking this class! :)
author: Luísa M
